mapper.select:
select d.type_code, d.data_code, d.data_value, d.sort_order, d.description, d.is_active as `active` from dict_data d
and d.type_code like concat(#{dictDataPageQueryDTO.typeCode}, '%')
and d.data_code like concat(#{dictDataPageQueryDTO.dataCode}, '%')
and d.data_value like concat(#{dictDataPageQueryDTO.dataValue}, '%')
and d.is_active = #{dictDataPageQueryDTO.active}
order by d.type_code, d.sort_order
